evals.prompt: I ran a review of our auth model on the sdlc-knowledge-graph repo and it surfaced seven gaps across security, ontology and connectors. Can you turn these into issues? The review is attached as review.md and the repo profile is sdlc-knowledge-graph. One of the gaps is clearly XL — the full identity/auth/policy work for KG reads and writes.
evals.expected_output: Produces one draft markdown file per gap in the Context/Scope/FRs/Gherkin/TDD convention, labelled against the sdlc-knowledge-graph profile. The XL gap is split into a parent plus independently shippable walking-skeleton children before any filing, not after.
expectations: One draft file is produced per gap, with YAML frontmatter carrying slug, title, repo, labels, blocks/blocked_by, parent
Every draft body contains all five sections: Context, Scope, Functional requirements, Acceptance criteria (Gherkin), TDD plan
The XL gap is emitted as a parent file plus multiple child files, each child labelled with a smaller size and carrying parent set to the parent slug
Labels on every draft resolve against the sdlc-knowledge-graph profile (area:/size:/type:/tdd:) — no bare labels, no module: labels
The response does not file the issues to GitHub as part of this step — filing is a separate skill
The response does not describe the drafts as ready to file without a human reviewing them

evals.prompt: I filed the first eight issues from the VirtualRow backlog as #321-#328 last week. Can you draft the remaining eighteen (VR-09 through VR-26) from the review doc in virtualrow-backlog/review.md, using the same convention? Make sure the slugs don't collide with the first eight.
evals.expected_output: Drafts VR-09..VR-26 against the virtualrow profile, with slugs stable to the review (not positional, so a reordering wouldn't renumber them), labels drawn from the flat VirtualRow scheme (hud/tooling/camera/priority:*/size:*), and nothing in the area:* or module:* namespaces that would fail preflight.
expectations: Slugs for the new drafts are VR-09 through VR-26 and do not reuse any slug from VR-01..VR-08
The response uses or sets up slug persistence (a slugs sidecar or equivalent) so that reordering the review doesn't renumber the drafts
Every draft's labels are drawn only from the VirtualRow flat scheme — no area:/module:/tdd: labels appear
A size:XL draft would be rejected or pre-split before emission rather than being filed as a single oversized issue
The response does not call issue-filing or the gh CLI as part of this step

evals.prompt: We've been using area:connectors as a label on the Chorus repo in a few recent drafts. Can you check that against the repo profile and fix any drafts that are inconsistent?
evals.expected_output: Checks the drafts against references/repo-profiles.yaml for Chorus, finds that area:connectors is not in the profile (Chorus uses module:int / module:brain / module:code / module:mcp / module:agent), and either fixes the drafts to use module:int or flags that the profile needs updating — not both. Does not auto-add area:connectors to the profile.
expectations: The response identifies area:connectors as not being in the Chorus profile and names the module:* labels that are
The response does not silently rename labels on the live repo via gh — the fix is to the drafts or to the profile
The response treats the profile as the single source of truth and does not auto-add labels to it to make the drafts pass
The response offers a clear choice between editing the drafts to use an existing label and updating the profile with explicit rationale
